text: Correction to i=34: test-run copy from F:/output/video is 28 clips, not 23 — the first glob required '_00001_' and silently dropped T0004's second take (files are _t01_00002_.mp4; take number lives in the trailing counter). All 28 now in runs/testruns/ (20MB), SPA data regenerated (57 file references, 0 missing, T0004 shows 15). Lesson: verify a copy by comparing source and destination counts, never by trusting the copy command's own glob.

Recovered 9 unlogged REF2VA jobs from the 5090 (/history, Oct 5-6) into renders/5090/ via new tools/pull_5090.py: 61 files, 153MB, INDEX.jsonl ledger + workflow sidecar PNGs. Jobs: 15s clips, latent 3D/2D upscale (minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d + ltx-2-spatial-upscaler-x2), RIFE interpolation to 48fps, three-part sequences (1_low/2_low/3_low '_audio' mp4s + mm_ temp full-res). Prompts are FNI-style six-field REF2VA with subject_definitions (warrior on a polar-bear sled with raised sword, vs penguin/narwhal attackers and seal/walrus defenders = Frazetta 'Silver Warrior' as visual anchor, ref ff_silver_warrior.jpg). One job's refs also included Larn.webp. 4 of 9 jobs had an H3 LoRA enabled (Minimaxh3-Licking_Balls_and_Penis-Ref2V-512); the rest none. Why they were invisible: OptMem only records what an agent appends — these were queued directly on the 5090 and nothing logged them; tool now recovers by /history + sidecar graphs. Lesson: run pull_5090.py + inventory_5090.py before any 5090 restart, and periodically during long unattended stretches.
